learning_outcomes.text: To know the methodological foundations of industrial design.
To apply industrial design methodologies to solve problems in mechanical engineering, with a social and environmental perspective.
To be able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Presentation of the course and objectives
Topic 2: Industrial design phases. Analytical phase
Topic 2: Industrial design phases. Creative phase
Topic 2: Industrial design phases. Executive phase
teaching_methods: Presentation in the classroom of concepts related to the subjects that make up each topic and problem-solving sessions
Other face-to-face group sessions such as discussion classes, sharing, etc.
Completion of work in small groups
Personal study, report writing, practical work, etc. as independent work by the student or group of students

assessment_methods.method: Exams (comprising Exam 1 for Topics 1, 2, 3 and Exam 2 for Topics 4, 5, 6)

assessment_rules: For approval, the student must obtain a grade equal to or greater than 5 and greater than 3 in each of the parts. In the ordinary and extraordinary calls, grades are not saved, so the student takes the entire course.
